summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management filed a routine Form -K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting preliminary assets under management as of September 30, 2026, totaling $168.7 billion, split between $90.2 billion in Artisan Funds and Artisan Global Funds and $78.5 billion in separate accounts and other AUM. The filing attaches a press release (Exhibit 99.1) with strategy-level AUM detail and is signed by CFO Charles J. Daley, Jr. No transaction, stakeholder, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed; this is an ordinary monthly operating update with no risk-arb angle.
